Chapter 777: Chapter 5 Ninth-Level Citizen (Subscribe, Please)_2

Chapter 777: Chapter 5 Ninth-Level Citizen (Subscribe, please)_2

“””

“Spreading one’s own evolution path, allowing more beings to cultivate, and ultimately nourishing one’s self to propel the ultimate leap… Such means are nothing short of incredible…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that this kind of nourishment was not the kind that came from the power of faith but rather from the path of evolution, basically without any hidden dangers.

“I wonder which powerful being created this cultivation method? An existence close to a Perfect Time Being?”

Lin Yuan was quite curious.

In the long-gone Cosmic Era, there was no talk of spreading one’s own evolution path. If you wanted to make the ultimate leap, you essentially had to rely on yourself.

...

Take Emperor Xuanhuang for example; he did not spread his evolution path widely because the threshold for the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path was too high and not suitable for aimless dissemination.

…

“It’s about time.”

“It’s time to advance to a Ninth-Level Citizen.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the balance of his own Merit Points, five billion and two hundred million.

Out of these, fifty billion Merit Points were the reward he received after uploading the Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

The remaining two billion plus Merit Points were what Lin Yuan had accumulated over time, including what was left from the last time he uploaded the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

“From an Eighth-Level Citizen to a Ninth-Level Citizen, ten billion Merit Points are needed, equivalent to the value of ten entry-level Twelve-Star Rare Treasures.”

After pondering for a moment, Lin Yuan chose to upgrade his citizen level.

In the past, every time he advanced his citizen level, he gained far more than the value of the Merit Points spent on the advancement itself.

The higher the citizen level, the more important it was not just the privileges but also the ability to influence some of the decisions of Human Civilization.

Take Lin Yuan, for instance, he was currently the Chief Speaker of the North Cold Star Alliance, the highest-ranking individual in hundreds, if not thousands, of Star Domains, and a single thought from him was enough to determine Human Civilization’s policy towards the surrounding Different Species.

The ordinary tribes within the North Cold Star Alliance, the weaker tribes, or even the other Different Species tribes nearby, all had to rely on Lin Yuan’s influence.

“Goddess of Wisdom.”

“I wish to now advance to a Ninth-Level Citizen.”

Lin Yuan immediately connected to the Goddess of Wisdom and made a request to upgrade his citizen level.

In an instant,

Lin Yuan’s five billion and more Merit Points were reduced by ten billion.

At the same time,

The citizen level section on Lin Yuan’s personal information page quietly changed from eighth to ninth level.

Ninth-Level Citizen.

Ninth-Level Citizen of Human Civilization.

This was a weight that not just any Star Domain, even a Star Alliance, could hardly bear.

Even among the many Eleventh-Rank Evolvers of Human Civilization, most were not Ninth-Level Citizens.

Even for powerful Eleventh-Rank Evolvers, accumulating ten billion Merit Points would require a huge sacrifice.

The ancient Tenth Rank Evolver from the Xuanyuan Family, Xuanyuan Fan, who had fought for one to two million years on the Battlefields of Different Species, had only accumulated twenty million Merit Points at the end.

To gain the opportunity to comprehend the mysteries of a black planet, he had to borrow eighty million Merit Points on behalf of his family from Human Civilization to make up a total of one billion Merit Points to complete the transaction with Lin Yuan.

If someone ancient like Xuanyuan Fan had to do this, Eleventh-Rank Evolvers with more accumulated Merit Points would not be too far ahead.

Moreover, most Evolvers cannot resist the temptation to spend some of their Merit Points during the accumulation process.

Just like Xuanyuan Fan, who, wanting to increase his chances of advancing to Tier 11, chose to spend the twenty million Merit Points he had saved up in advance.

After all, Merit Points have too high a value in Human Civilization, able to exchange for many unimaginably valuable resources and heritages.

It is only a very few, like Lin Yuan, who save up every Merit Point to upgrade their citizen level.

Using Merit Points to advance citizen level is indeed the most valuable approach, but the greatest value does not mean the highest short-term return.

…

Whoosh.

Just after Lin Yuan smoothly advanced to a Ninth-Level Citizen,

a flurry of ’emails’ from the Central Star Field of Human Civilization were all sent over.

These ’emails’, aside from congratulating Lin Yuan, were introductions to the many privileges of a Ninth-Level Citizen.

“Privileges for a Ninth-Level Citizen…”

Lin Yuan browsed through the ’emails’ one by one.

The first were the standard benefits, one would receive a Ninth-Rank Evolution Elixir.

Starting from a Sixth-Level Citizen, with each advancement in citizenship level, one would receive a corresponding Evolution Elixir.

Even the lowest Sixth-Rank Evolution Elixir, it’s a specially allocated resource. Even if you have an abundance of Cosmic Crystals, you cannot buy it.

Only Merit Points can be used to exchange for one, with a Sixth-Rank Evolution Elixir requiring ten thousand Merit Points.

A Seventh-Rank Evolution Elixir requires one hundred thousand Merit Points.

An Eighth-Rank Evolution Elixir requires a million Merit Points.

A Ninth-Rank Evolution Elixir requires ten million Merit Points.

Furthermore, to exchange for an Evolution Elixir, you also need to have the corresponding authorization. Lower-level citizens, even if they accumulate enough Merit Points, cannot make the exchange.

“The right to participate in the Central Council of Human Civilization…” Lin Yuan glanced at the second benefit.

The Central Council of Human Civilization is a key meeting that touches on the future direction of the entirety of Human Civilization, where Supreme Beings will descend their consciousness to participate, and the three goddesses will pay close attention.

To be able to participate in such meetings, you need at least a Ninth-Level Citizen status.

“Not interested.”

Lin Yuan had no interest in the council. Such a privilege might be invaluable to some citizens adept at maneuvering through politics, but to Lin Yuan, it seemed meaningless.

“Hmm? Three opportunities to immerse in the Eternal Spring?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze lingered on a particular benefit.

The Eternal Spring, one of the Human Civilization’s Twelve-Star Rare Treasures, allows any bather to safely extend their lifespan by several hundred thousand years.

Moreover, during the immersion in the Eternal Spring, one’s physique will undergo slow transformation, improving the potential upper limits.
